lore: The DiskSaver canal climbs from the harbour to the upper basin through a single lock. Every island in the census sends one boat, as long as the memory its island needs, and they queue in the order they arrive. Lockkeeper Wilhelmina fills the chamber, closes the gates and works the paddles; one cycle takes half an hour whether she lifts one boat or three. Waiting for a fuller chamber saves cycles but keeps early boats idle. Plan the groups so the fleet waits least.

lines.smooth: Not a minute more waiting than the canal allows. The basin's full and nobody's grumbling.
lines.slow: They all got through, but some boats sat idle longer than they needed. Don't always wait for a full chamber.
lines.jammed: That plan won't work the gates: the chamber's overfull, or the groups don't add up to the queue.
